name: Twilight's Run
summary: Beneath Staghelm Point in northern Silithus, Twilight's Run shelters the Twilight's Hammer. Its cavern walls shield their rituals and forces from the desert winds.

sections.title: A Subterranean Redoubt
sections.body:
Beneath Staghelm Point, Twilight's Run opens into the northern cliffs of Silithus. The Twilight's Hammer has made its tunnels a stronghold, sheltered from desert winds and the silithid hives that roam the dunes. Its cultists gather to commune with dark forces, guard ritual materials, and marshal their forces.

Vyral the Vile and other overseers direct the cultists. They keep a hostile watch and stand ready to strike down any traveler or scout who comes too close.

faq.answer: Twilight's Run lies in the northern mountains of Silithus, beneath Staghelm Point.
The Twilight's Hammer occupies Twilight's Run. Among them are Vyral the Vile, Twilight Overlords, and Twilight Flamereavers.

faq.q: What is the cult doing inside the cavern?
aliases: why are cultists in twilights run
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer uses Twilight's Run as a sheltered outpost. There, the cult keeps out of the desert winds while pursuing its apocalyptic work.

angles.text: As a paladin, you may find the zealous nihilists in Twilight's Run an affront to the holy tenets of the Light. They serve dark powers.
